sources.citation: D. R. Godden, A. D. Baddeley (1975). CONTEXT‐DEPENDENT MEMORY IN TWO NATURAL ENVIRONMENTS: ON LAND AND UNDERWATER. British Journal of Psychology.
sources.notes: Foundational primary study (1975) in British Journal of Psychology establishing the core experimental paradigm and quantitative parameters.

sources.citation: Duncan Godden, Alan Baddeley (1980). When does context influence recognition memory? British Journal of Psychology.
sources.notes: Demonstrates that switching between land and underwater environments leaves forced-choice recognition intact when extrinsic environmental cues are unnecessary for retrieval.

sources.citation: Steven M. Smith, Edward Vela, John E. Williamson (1988). Shallow input processing does not induce environmental context-dependent recognition. Bulletin of the Psychonomic Society.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (1988) in Bulletin of the Psychonomic Society extending the foundational findings.

sources.citation: Jaap M. J. Murre (2021). The Godden and Baddeley (1975) experiment on context-dependent memory on land and underwater: a replication. Royal Society Open Science.
sources.notes: Subsequent empirical and theoretical investigation (2021) in Royal Society Open Science extending the foundational findings.
